prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1413; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked and displaced on the driver's side, with the trunk lid edge deformed and the left tail lamp housing broken. The reinforcement bar appears bent but is not yet fully exposed for inspection. Some of the scuffing on the lower quarter panel may predate this impact, though it is hard to tell from the photos alone. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known to us. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp, straightening the trunk lid, and refinishing the affected panels. The bills submitted show no repeated charges, and the labor hours requested fit the damage described.
